info.name: Midjourney Image Analysis Image Generation API
Generate images from a text prompt

items.docs: Submits a text prompt to generate a grid of up to four unique images using Midjourney's AI models. The request is processed asynchronously and returns a job identifier that can be used to poll for results or receive updates via webhook. Supports parameters for aspect ratio, model version, quality, stylization, and other generation settings embedded in the prompt string or as separate parameters.
